activity.notes: The Arms Control Association records that Soviet Air Defense Forces Lieutenant Colonel Stanislav Petrov was on duty on 26 September 1983 when the early-warning system indicated a U.S. missile attack and that he judged the alarm false. ATLAS records the exact duty-day incident without claiming that he personally held nuclear launch authority or that a world war was counterfactually certain.

sources.title: Man Who 'Saved the World' Dies at 77 - Arms Control Association
sources.citation_text: The Arms Control Association describes Petrov's duty on 26 September 1983 and his judgment that the Soviet missile-warning alert was false.
